naming_convention: JM1_<Domain>_<Capability> or JM1<Domain><Capability> with publisher JM1/JMerrillOne/domain publisher.
publisher_convention: JM1 for enterprise core, JMPublishing/JMFinancial/JMFoundation/JM1Editorial for division-owned solutions.
semantic_versioning: major.minor.patch.build; increment patch/build for deployment proof and minor for functional additions.
managed_expectation: Unmanaged in DEV; managed in TEST/UAT and PROD where supported.
production_import_rule: No new production unmanaged import unless documented exception.
source_control_rule: Solution exports and deployment evidence stored in repository or approved artifact store.
connection_reference_rule: All solution flows must use connection references; production references must avoid personal accounts where service/shared mailbox identity is available.
environment_variable_rule: Environment-specific URLs, IDs, feature flags, and non-secret config use environment variables; secrets use approved secret store.
deployment_evidence_rule: Capture package, version, actor, source, target, timestamp, validation, and rollback.
rollback_rule: Use prior managed solution version where available; otherwise restore from exported solution/source-controlled state.
